sn4.20:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati Himavantapadese arañña-kuṭikāyaṃ || || Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || || sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocayaṃ dhammenā ti || ||
sn4.20:2.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kāretu bhante Bhagavā rajjaṃ kāretu Sugato rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā ti || || Kiṃ pana tvaṃ pāpima passasi yam maṃ tvam evaṃ vadesi || || kāretu bhante Bhagavā rajjaṃ kāretu Sugato rajjaṃ || pe || dhammenā ti || || Bhagavatā kho bhante cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā || ākaṅkhamāno ca pana bhante Bhagavā Himavantam pabbatarājaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ tveva adhimucceyya || suvaṇṇañca pabbatassāti || ||
sn4.20:3.1: Pabbatassa suvaṇṇassa || jātarūpassa kevalo || dvittā va nālam ekassa || iti vidvā samañcare || ||
sn4.20:4.1: yo dukkham addakkhi yato nidānaṃ || kāmesu so jantu kathaṃ nameyya || upadhiṃ viditvā saṅgo ti loke || tass-eva jantu vinayāya sikkhe ti || ||
sn4.20:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || Dutiyo vaggo || ||
sn4.20:6.0: Tass-uddānam || || Pāsāno Sīho Sakalikam || Patirūpañ ca Mānasaṃ || Pattaṃ Āyātanaṃ Piṇḍaṃ || Kassakaṃ Rajjena te dasā ti || || ___________________________________________
